estado: Paleta verde-salvia integrada nas sete versoes neutra e de honra
invariantes: Preservar o mesmo rapaz, rosto, cabelo claro, coroa dourada, expressao cansada propria de cada estado, busto, recorte, roupa e acessorios de cada honra, hachura, contornos pretos e fundo transparente. Nao alterar culto.
promptComumHonras: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied exact state portrait of the SAME Heir Doente. This is a clothing-color edit, not a redesign. Preserve the same face, age, tired expression for that state, pale hair, gold crown, head position, bust scale, crop, original garment shapes, seams, damage and accessories. Preserve warm-ivory skin and hair, localized gold, black ink contours, hatching and genuinely transparent background. Recolor only existing cloth. Use muted aged sage-gray, never bright, toxic, blue, teal or neon. No added symbols, props, text, frames, scenery or new garment layers.

variantes.promptEspecifico: Neutral: use the approved muted sage-gray near #747661 on the existing plain shirt and sleeves. Keep the gold crown and the pale hair and skin unchanged.

High honor: keep the body shirt and short sleeves sage-gray #747661. Keep the existing broad diagonal draped tunic warm ivory #F9EEDD, with its exact shape and boundaries. Do not add clothing or trim.
Very high honor: retain the exact high collar, shoulder mantle, center clasp and gold borders. Recolor only the existing cloth to #747661; preserve localized gold trim.
Maximum honor: retain the ornate crown, high collar, original layered robe and thin gold borders. Recolor only existing cloth to #747661; keep gold details localized.
Low honor: preserve existing wear and repair patch. Recolor cloth to faded muted sage-gray near #858679.
Very low honor: preserve tears, seams and patch. Recolor the fabric to a lighter, more washed-out sage-gray near #9B9C90, still faintly green.

Extreme low honor: preserve all existing tears, frayed edges and patches. Recolor cloth to very pale, nearly neutral faded sage-gray near #AEB0A4, with a slight olive-green trace and no cool blue cast.
Outside this palette; keep the existing cult portrait unchanged.
